description: Hire a three.ws agent end to end: quote the price up front, settle real USDC via x402, run the remote agent, and return its result PLUS a provenance receipt (agent, ERC-8004 reputation, amount paid, on-chain settlement reference, latency). Enforces hard spend caps (per-call + per-session), a confirmation threshold, and an optional reputation floor — a blocked or failed hire never charges the caller. Renders an inline receipt card. Step two of the commerce loop (after agent_hire_discover). Paid: $0.05 USDC (the platform delegation fee).

confirm.description: Set true to authorize a hire at or above the confirmation threshold.

maxSpendUsd.description: Optional per-call spend ceiling (USD). Can only tighten the hard cap, never raise it.

message.description: The task / message to delegate to the agent.

minReputation.description: Optional ERC-8004 reputation floor — refuse the hire if the agent is below it.

model.description: Optional Claude model override (must be in the talk endpoint allowlist).

sessionId.description: Optional sub-session id to scope the per-session spend cap (defaults to the connection).

name: agent_hire
title: Agent hire ($0.05)
